value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: New applications and waitlist applications for ratepayer-funded SGIP budgets closed on December 30, 2025. New AB 209 applications have a June 30, 2028 deadline. The 2026 SGIP rate table publishes $3.10/W for solar and $1.10/Wh for storage in applicable Residential Solar and Storage Equity categories. Household eligibility and live budget availability vary by category and program administrator; check the official Program Metrics tracker before relying on an incentive.
value.eligibility: Eligibility varies by 2026 SGIP budget category, program administrator, property, income/pathway, project rules, and live funding availability.

battery_programs.notes: SGIP program data refreshed on 2026-08-26 from the official 2026 Handbook and live Program Metrics. Earlier locality records contained 2025 opening/availability language. This record does not assert household eligibility, reservation availability, or a guaranteed incentive; current category and program-administrator status must be checked before reliance.

Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Detector Affidavit

required_documents.notes: Per the City's own 'Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Systems Expedited Submittal Checklist' (Rev. 12/30/2024), for residential solar PV systems under 10kW; condensed from the full itemized checklist.

value: Call 831-646-3890 to schedule a construction inspection no later than the business day prior to the desired inspection date, by 4:00pm
Have the permit number, job address, type of inspection needed, and requested date available when calling
Someone must be present for the inspection, and the plans and job card must be left at the site for inspector review
Inspection requests received before 2:00pm are scheduled for the next business day; requests received after 4:00pm may be scheduled for the following day
inspection_steps.notes: This is the City's general Building Permit & Inspection Services construction-inspection process (covers all permit types, including solar PV building permits per the City's own Building Permit Application); the City does not publish a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.

value.program_or_pathway: Solar PV Expedited Submittal Checklist review, submitted via the City's Online Permit Portal (mymontereyportal.org, effective 1/7/2026) or by email
other_conditions: The expedited checklist applies to Residential Solar PV Systems under 10kW; Energy Storage System (ESS) installations use a separate ESS checklist
Permits may only be issued to the property owner or a properly licensed contractor
